sources.title: Deep Q-Learning Variants for Lunar Lander - GitHub
sources.snippet: Implementation and comparison of four Deep Q-Learning variants—Classic DQN, Double DQN, Dueling DQN, and Dueling Double DQN (D3QN)—for the Lunar Lander-v3 environment using PyTorch. Includes neural network architectures, replay buffer, target networks, epsilon-greedy exploration, training loop, and performance evaluation.

sources.title: GitHub - ChienTeLee/dueling_dqn_lunar_lander
sources.snippet: In this project, we build a Dueling Deep Q Network with Experience Replay as an reinforcement learning agent to solve the discrete Lunar Lander environment in OpenAI Gym. The goal of this environment is to land the Lunar Lander on the Landing pad with zero speed. This task is considered solved when the average reward is +200 points.
